title: Arecanut — Koleroga, Yellow Leaf Disease, Stem Bleeding
content:
MAJOR DISEASES OF ARECANUT:

1. KOLEROGA (Mahali) — Phytophthora arecae:
Most destructive disease in Karnataka coastal/Malnad region.
Symptoms: Water-soaked lesion on nuts, rapid nut fall, white mycelium on fallen nuts.
Management:
- Bordeaux mixture 1% (CuSO4 1% + Lime 1%) spray MONTHLY from June to October.
- Remove and bury fallen infected nuts.
- Tridemorph (Calixin) 80 EC @ 0.1% spray as alternative.
- Spray nut bunches and lower canopy thoroughly.
Prevention: Do not allow dense shade — improve air circulation.

2. YELLOW LEAF DISEASE (YLD) — Mycoplasma/Phytoplasma:
Symptoms: Yellowing of fronds (younger first), leaf size reduction, small nuts, palm decline.
Management: NO CHEMICAL CURE available.
- Remove and destroy severely affected palms.
- Control insect vectors (leafhoppers, mites) with Imidacloprid.
- Oxytetracycline trunk injection — temporary relief only.
- Use disease-free planting material from certified nurseries.

3. STEM BLEEDING (Phytophthora palmivora):
Symptoms: Red-brown liquid oozing from trunk, dark rotted internal tissue.
Management: Scrape affected bark, apply Bordeaux paste (10 kg CuSO4 + 10 kg lime in 100L water) on wound.
Alt: Fosetyl-Al (Aliette) 0.3% drench at stem base. Repeat monthly.

4. BUD ROT (Phytophthora arecae):
Symptoms: Central spindle turns brown/rotten, rotten smell, coconut-like internal damage.
Management: Remove infected tissue, apply Bordeaux paste. Metalaxyl 0.1% drench.

5. ANABE DISEASE (Ganoderma boninense):
Symptoms: Bracket fungal growth at base of palm, yellowing, rapid decline.
Management: No chemical control. Remove affected palm. Drench soil with Carbendazim 0.1%.
